IPT.evidence_source: [page/0/Text/5] This study evaluated the efficacy of cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT) and interpersonal psychotherapy (IPX) with depressed adolescents in Puerto Rico.

dxgive.evidence_source: [page/0/Text/5] Seventy-one adolescents meeting Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (3rd ed., rev.; American Psychiatric Association, 1987) criteria for a diagnosis of depression were randomly assigned to 1 of 3 conditions: CBT, IPT, or wait list (WL).

Source.evidence_source: [page/0/Text/5] Pretreatment, posttreatment, and 3-month follow-up measures of depression symptoms, self-esteem, social adjustment, family emotional involvement and criticism, and behavioral problems were completed.
